mapper.select: SELECT -- Cột bảng Carts c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.num_items_in_cart, c.cart_total, c.shipping, c.tax, c.order_total, -- Cột bảng CartItems (Đổi tên để tránh trùng lặp) ci.cart_item_id, ci.amount, ci.created_at as ci_created_at, ci.updated_at as ci_updated_at, ci.cart_id as ci_cart_id, ci.product_id as ci_product_id, -- Cột bảng Products p.product_id as p_product_id, p.name as product_name, p.image as product_image, p.price as product_price, p.company as product_company FROM public.carts c LEFT JOIN public.cart_items ci ON c.cart_id = ci.cart_id LEFT JOIN public.products p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC

SELECT -- Cột bảng Carts c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.num_items_in_cart, c.cart_total, c.shipping, c.tax, c.order_total, -- Cột bảng CartItems (Đổi tên để tránh trùng lặp) ci.cart_item_id, ci.amount, ci.created_at as ci_created_at, ci.updated_at as ci_updated_at, ci.cart_id as ci_cart_id, ci.product_id as ci_product_id, -- Cột bảng Products p.product_id as p_product_id, p.name as product_name, p.image as product_image, p.price as product_price, p.company as product_company FROM public.carts c LEFT JOIN public.cart_items ci ON c.cart_id = ci.cart_id LEFT JOIN public.products p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id WHERE c.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY ci.created_at DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ci.amount), 0)::int FROM carts c LEFT JOIN cart_items ci ON ci.cart_id = c.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = CAST(#{userId} AS UUID)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carts ( user_id, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 'ACTIVE' ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' DO NOTHING
mapper.update: WITH deleted AS ( DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} ) UPDATE carts SET num_items_in_cart = 0, cart_total = 0, shipping = 0, tax = 0, order_total = 0 WHERE cart_id = #{cartId}
mapper.select: SELECT cart_id, num_items_in_cart, cart_total, shipping, tax, tax_rate, order_total, created_at, updated_at, user_id, status FROM carts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE carts SET status = 'LOCKED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE carts SET status = 'CHECKED_OUT', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND status = 'LOCKED'
